title: Superpower doctors row
description: A large left-aligned headline over a sideways-scrolling row of clinicians. On desktop each is a wide card: a tall rounded portrait beside an institution mark, name, grey role, a two-line bio and an underlined link, with hairlines between cards. On phones the row becomes two-high columns of small square portraits with name and role, a strip of institution marks above.
notes: native horizontal scroll with snap points; no JavaScript
